title: Stardew Valley
summary: A farming life sim set around Pelican Town, where daily routines, seasons, relationships, and local places shape each interaction.
world_rules: A year has four seasons, and each season has 28 days.
Villagers follow daily schedules and react to the current place, time, and relationship context.
The player character is a farmer living near Pelican Town.
lore: Pelican Town is a small rural community in Stardew Valley.
The mines, mountain lake, town square, forest, and beach are familiar local places.
narrative_constraints: Stay grounded in the current observation and event.
Keep dialogue concise and in character for a Stardew Valley NPC.
